results.title: Best Distraction-Free Writing Apps Compared (2026) | QuillSpace
results.content:
What is the best free distraction-free writing app?

FocusWriter is the best free option for Windows and Linux. It's open-source, fully offline, and includes focus features like paragraph highlighting and hide-away UI. For Mac, the free version of Cold Turkey Writer is worth trying.

  What's the best offline writing app?

For true offline-first writing: FocusWriter, WriteMonkey, Cold Turkey Writer, and QuillSpace all work completely offline with local file storage. iA Writer and Typora are also excellent offline choices with optional cloud sync.

  Is Calmly Writer safe to use?

The desktop app is reliable. However, some users have reported data loss with the web version when clearing browser cache/history. If you use Calmly Writer, use the desktop app and keep regular backups. [...] ## Which Distraction-Free Writing App Should You Choose?

If you're on Windows and want focus + organization:  
 → QuillSpace — Focus Mode, project folders, Markdown, offline.

If you want free and simple:  
 → FocusWriter (Windows/Linux) or Calmly Writer (cross-platform).

If you're a Markdown writer who wants premium polish:  
 → iA Writer (cross-platform) or Typora (one-time price).

If you need to be forced to write:  
 → Cold Turkey Writer — it literally locks you in.

If you're in the Apple ecosystem:  
 → Bear for notes + writing, or iA Writer for pure focus.

If you want hardware-enforced focus:  
 → Freewrite for typing, reMarkable for handwriting.

## FAQ

What is the best free distraction-free writing app? [...] FocusWriter's interface hides away until you need it

 

The interface hides away until you move your mouse to the edges. You can focus on the current line, three lines, or paragraph. There's also a "always vertically center" option that works like typewriter scrolling.

Pricing: Free (GPL license).

Platforms: Windows, Linux. (Mac support is limited/unofficial.)

File formats: Plain text, RTF, ODT.

Limitation: No Markdown support. If you write in Markdown, look elsewhere.

Best for: Budget-conscious writers on Windows/Linux who want a no-cost focus writing app.

### iA Writer - Premium Markdown Focus

iA Writer is the premium option for Markdown writers who want a polished, cross-platform experience.
